description: Land Aquisition - Maradana, Beruwala D/S Division,Kalutara District.
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed ownership information, property boundaries, encumbrances, and legal status. The content focuses entirely on land property rights and title settlements, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
